candidates.decision_relevance: Would distinguish narrow ETH/BTC or BTC-led resilience from broad participation and test whether breadth deterioration preceded or followed price weakness.
candidates.evidence_reference: Repeated reviews state that only changing-membership top-100 proxy breadth is available and canonical broad-alt or large-cap breadth is missing.
candidates.metric_name: Fixed-universe broad and large-cap breadth participation series
candidates.missing_history_problem: No prior-day or intraday history with stable universe, constituent returns, advancer counts, and participation persistence is supplied; the proxy cannot establish whether deterioration was broad, persistent, or merely compositional.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would test whether liquidation and microstructure stress led price weakness, represented transient deleveraging, or was a consequence of the drawdown.
candidates.evidence_reference: Reviews repeatedly describe liquidation data as lower bounds with unverified completeness and note missing sequence information for flow, depth, open interest, and price.
candidates.metric_name: Complete liquidation, positioning, flow, and order-book event history
candidates.missing_history_problem: Only fragile, lower-bound snapshots are supplied; there is no reliable historical event stream, composition by long/short, venue coverage, or lead-lag path against subsequent returns.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would test whether settled ETF demand persisted across sessions and translated into price and participation support despite weak breadth and ETH-relative performance.
candidates.evidence_reference: The weekly review explicitly says the required settled ETF sequence is unavailable; daily reviews generally contain only one stale settled session.
candidates.metric_name: Multi-session settled BTC and ETH ETF flow sequence
candidates.missing_history_problem: A single retained session cannot establish persistence, concentration, within-week sequencing, or whether flows offset deterioration; proxy breadth therefore cannot be independently checked against the intended completed-week series.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would provide contemporaneous macro context for separating crypto-specific rotation or distribution from broader liquidity and risk-premium conditions.
candidates.evidence_reference: Multiple daily reviews report empty, unavailable, or stale macro context, including stale dollar-index observations.
candidates.missing_history_problem: No current or recent macro sequence is supplied, so the analyses cannot determine whether crypto weakness or re-acceleration occurred alongside a changing macro backdrop.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would test whether available stablecoin liquidity was being deployed into risk assets and whether supportive supply conditions translated into participation.
candidates.evidence_reference: Reviews state that stablecoin supply is available only as context and does not establish deployment or risk appetite.
candidates.metric_name: Stablecoin supply, exchange-balance, and deployment-flow history
candidates.missing_history_problem: The supplied observations do not show time-varying deployment, venue balances, or risk-asset absorption, leaving supportive liquidity versus idle supply unresolved.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would quantify false positives, false negatives, range containment, and timing errors for the recurring warning and continuation interpretations.
candidates.evidence_reference: All weekly reviews report null or absent matured outcomes and zero matured exit-calibration rows.
candidates.metric_name: Matured candidate and warning outcome scorecard
candidates.missing_history_problem: Candidate specifications, issue cutoffs, point-in-time inputs, realized paths, and maturation results are absent or incomplete, preventing empirical calibration and opportunity-cost measurement.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would test hindsight leakage, timestamp alignment, feature dependence, and whether the three prior candidates were precise rather than broad-range retrospective descriptions.
candidates.evidence_reference: Weekly reviews repeatedly report that three prior candidates existed but their objects, issue times, metric paths, ranges, thresholds, and feature snapshots are omitted.
candidates.metric_name: Archived candidate objects with point-in-time feature snapshots
candidates.missing_history_problem: The supplied package cannot reconstruct what information was available at each forecast issue time or inspect candidate precision, overlap, dependence, and falsifiability.
